page: Microsoft Azure DC48as_cc_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCACCV5 server family. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server features 48 virtual CPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. The processor includes an L1 data cache of 32 KB, an L2 cache of 0.5 MB, and an L3 cache of 32 MB. Supported instruction sets include AVX, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, though AVX-512 is not supported. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng scores placing the instance in the top 25% of tested servers. The system demonstrates high efficiency in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, ray tracing, image processing, and PassMark CPU encryption tests. Memory performance is also robust, with a PassMark memory score in the top 25%, though uncached large-block memory bandwidth reads and writes remain in the average tier. For language model workloads, the server achieves strong inference speeds when processing prompts and generating text with small 135M models. However, performance drops to average for medium 7B models, and it exhibits poor text generation speeds of 2.53 tokens per second with large 70B models, highlighting a clear tradeoff for heavy AI workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the DC48as_cc_v5 offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise-grade workloads that do not require local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC cores and a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it highly suitable for general-purpose applications, multi-threaded software compilation, web serving, and database operations. It is also well-suited for cryptographic tasks and image processing due to its strong hardware-accelerated instruction support.
